question: In which state is the Jog waterfalls situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jog Falls** is located in the state of **Karnataka**, India.
 
• It is the second highest plunge waterfall in India, created by the Sharavathi River dropping from a height of 253 meters (830 feet).
 
• The falls are a major tourist attraction and are particularly spectacular during the monsoon season when the water flow is at its peak.
 
• Jog Falls is also known as **Gersoppa Falls** or **Jogada Gundi**.
 
• The waterfall is divided into four distinct segments—Raja, Rani, Rover, and Rocket—which present a magnificent view when the water cascades down the rocky cliffs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Karnataka is known for its rich natural resources and diverse landscapes, including numerous rivers, waterfalls, forests, and beaches.
 
• Other famous waterfalls in Karnataka include Abbey Falls, Shivanasamudra Falls, and Unchalli Falls.
 
• Karnataka is also home to several national parks and wildlife sanctuaries, such as Bandipur National Park, Nagarhole National Park, and Bannerghatta National Park.
 
• The state has a rich cultural heritage, with historic cities like Mysore, Hampi, and Belur attracting tourists from around the world.
 
• Karnataka is known for its contributions to classical Indian music, dance, and literature, and it is a hub for technology and innovation in India.
